# TheSpark

> TheSpark (thespark.cash) is a wealth-building education platform that teaches financial literacy based on principles from The Richest Man in Babylon. We help Nigerians build lasting money habits through 21-day savings cycles, daily lessons, and progress tracking. TheSpark is a product of Gimablockchain, headquartered in Port Harcourt, Nigeria.

## About

- [About TheSpark](https://thespark.cash/about): The story behind TheSpark, the ancient wisdom of Babylon, our mission to help 1 million Nigerians build wealth, and how we work.
- [How It Works](https://thespark.cash/how-it-works): The 6-step process and the 8-cycle journey. Each cycle is 21 days. 8 cycles equals 6 months.
- [The 7 Rules of Wealth](https://thespark.cash/7-rules): The seven timeless principles from The Richest Man in Babylon, explained in depth.

## Frequently Asked Questions

- [FAQ](https://thespark.cash/faq): 157 questions and answers covering general information, how it works, premium plans, referrals, account, support, graduation, community, content, and technical topics.

## Key Facts

- Founder: Gideon Gideon
- Founded: 2026
- Headquarters: Port Harcourt, Rivers, Nigeria
- Parent company: Gimablockchain
- Industries: Financial Services, Education, Personal Finance
- Core program: 21-day savings cycles, 8 cycles to graduation
- Daily savings goals: from ₦100 to ₦20,000 depending on plan
- Mission: Help 1 million Nigerians build real wealth habits, one day at a time
